claim_gating_rules.confirmation_threshold: mean spearman_rho > 0 and CI lower > 0 for the relevant full, projection, and stratum gates
claim_gating_rules.confirmed: passes mean direction and CI-excludes-zero gates for the relevant claim
claim_gating_rules.confirmed_weak: final-paper wording when Stage 2 is confirmed and the effect-size label is small
claim_gating_rules.insufficient_samples: any required stratum has fewer than minimum_stratum_size traces
claim_gating_rules.projection_dependent: effect direction or qualitative result changes across pi_1 through pi_4
claim_gating_rules.qualified: mean direction passes but one pre-registered CI gate includes zero
claim_gating_rules.stratum_dependent: full set passes but multiple strata fail CI gates or any stratum has systematic mean direction failure
claim_gating_rules.supported: Stage 1 exploratory support only; never a Stage 2 or final-paper claim
claim_gating_rules.unsupported: full Stage 2 set fails the pre-registered direction

effect_size_bins.policy: Effect size is descriptive only and does not by itself determine confirmation.

fma_projection_policy.rule: FMA outputs are already step-level vectors. All four projections are still materialized in the audit, but they act as identity mappings for FMA rather than as selected token-to-step projections.

metric_definitions.target: rank agreement between s_B(r_i) and Delta_U(r_i)
pairwise rank concordance between s_B(r_i) and Delta_U(r_i)

metric_definitions.k_rule: k must be fixed before Stage 2 validation.
metric_definitions.target: top-k ranking quality for observed step-impact magnitude

projection_family.definition: For each trace step, sum evidence over tokens or units assigned to that step and divide by total absolute evidence mass in the trace.
projection_family.formula: score_j = sum_{a in step_j} e_a / sum_a abs(e_a)
projection_family.name: sum_normalized_pooling

projection_family.definition: For each trace step, average token-level or activation-level evidence assigned to that step.
projection_family.name: mean_pooling

projection_family.definition: For each trace step, compute the L2 norm of token-level or activation-level evidence assigned to that step.
projection_family.name: l2_norm_pooling

projection_family.definition: For each trace step, sum absolute evidence mass and divide by the number of tokens or units assigned to that step.
projection_family.formula: score_j = sum_{a in step_j} abs(e_a) / max(1, length(step_j))
projection_family.name: length_normalized_attribution_mass

registered_stage1_claims.claim: FMA step-level attribution scores positively rank observed held-out step-level delta_u.
The C1 direction is sign-consistent across pi_1 through pi_4 as a step-level representation audit.
The C1 direction holds across S_high, S_mid, S_low, and S_rand.

stage1_stage2_separation.stage1_allowed_use: exploration, calibration, and protocol freezing only

stratum_assignment_rule_g_T.assignment: Sort held-out traces by the frozen score plus fixed-seed hash tie breaker; slice into low, mid, and high tertiles. S_high, S_mid, and S_low are a mutually exclusive partition of Stage 2. S_rand is a fixed-seed uniform overlapping audit sample from all Stage 2 traces.
stratum_assignment_rule_g_T.name: frozen_structural_stability_quantile_rule
stratum_assignment_rule_g_T.taxonomy_entropy: normalized Shannon entropy over trace taxonomy labels
